reason: Broadens accepted input types for all_route_data (from Dictionary<string,string> to any IFluidIndexable) but only extracts string values, so existing dictionary usage still works while previously-broken/unsupported inputs now behave correctly, though filtering out non-string values could silently drop route data that relied on non-string types.
